title: [Master]-Bug 647018: Withholding tax for Employees and GL Accounts
summary: When a G/L account is used as the balance account on a General Journal line, the line now inherits the WHT product posting group from that G/L account. This lets withholding tax for employees be used outside expense management.
key_points: WHT product posting group is inherited from the G/L balance account on general journal lines
Change is in the WHT Expense Category Mgt. codeunit of the Expense Withholding Tax app
Intended to let employee WHT also cover other payment types, not only expenses
quote: WHT product posting group inherited from GL account to the General Journal line when used GL as a balance account.
